verdict.rationale: Audience activation is a fair question for a Segment-alternative data platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only event streaming to warehouses and SaaS destinations, plus a Profile Builder that writes profiles to the warehouse. Nothing documents audience or segment definitions, or syncing membership entries and exits to ad platforms or engagement tools. Event forwarding and warehouse profiles are adjacent features, not audience sync.

support.subject: As a marketer, audiences sync to ad platforms and engagement tools continuously, with membership entering and exiting in near-real-time
